smallTalk.response: Hey! I'm the BrandPulse assistant. Ask me about our services, how we work, pricing or the team, and I'll give you a straight answer.
I can answer questions about our 6 services (AI Solutions, Digital Marketing, Product Building, ERP, CRM and Strategic Consulting), how a project works, pricing, and who is on the team.
Happy to help! Anything else you want to know about BrandPulse?

faqs.question: What services does BrandPulse offer?
faqs.answer: We offer six services under one roof: AI Solutions (chat assistants, automation, data tools), Digital Marketing (social media, ads, SEO, landing pages), Product Building (websites, web apps, MVPs), ERP Systems (stock, orders, billing in one place), CRM Systems (lead tracking and follow-ups) and Strategic Consulting (planning your idea and choosing the right tools).

faqs.question: What is AI Solutions and what does it include?
faqs.answer: Practical AI for your business or idea: chat assistants trained on your own documents and FAQs, automations that handle repetitive tasks, and machine learning tools that turn your data into clear answers. We usually start with one small pilot so you can see the value before expanding.

faqs.question: What is Digital Marketing at BrandPulse?
faqs.answer: We help the right people find you: social media content and management, Google and Meta ads, basic SEO, Google Business Profile, and landing pages that turn visitors into enquiries. We set up tracking so you can see what each rupee brings in.

faqs.question: What is Product Building?
faqs.answer: We design, build and launch websites, portfolios, web apps and MVPs. For most projects we aim to show you a clickable first version within about two weeks, then build the full product with weekly updates.

faqs.question: What are ERP Systems and who are they for?
faqs.answer: An ERP brings your stock, orders, billing, payments and staff into one system instead of scattered spreadsheets and registers. It suits shops, distributors, manufacturers and service businesses that are outgrowing Excel.

faqs.question: What are CRM Systems and who are they for?
faqs.answer: A CRM tracks every lead and customer in one place, with WhatsApp, email and call notes together and automatic follow-up reminders. It helps any business that sells to customers and does not want to lose track of enquiries.

faqs.question: What is Strategic Consulting?
faqs.answer: Clear advice before you spend money on technology: turning your idea into features and wireframes, choosing the right tools for your budget, and mapping your processes to find what to fix or automate. You get a written roadmap you keep.

faqs.question: Who do you work with?
faqs.answer: Anyone with an idea or a business to grow: startups, small and growing business owners, students and individuals such as freelancers and professionals building a personal brand.

faqs.question: Do you help students?
faqs.answer: Yes. We build portfolio websites and personal brands, and help students turn project or startup ideas into working products. Tell us what you have in mind and your budget, and we will suggest a sensible scope.

faqs.question: Can you help a non-technical founder?
faqs.answer: Yes. We explain every step in plain language, help you decide what to build first, and hand over everything (code, hosting and accounts) at the end so you are never locked in.

faqs.question: Do you build mobile apps or online stores?
faqs.answer: Yes. We build mobile-friendly web apps and online stores, and can advise on a native mobile app when your project needs one. Book a free call and we will suggest the simplest option for your goal.

faqs.question: How much do your services cost?
faqs.answer: It depends on what you need. We scope every project to your goal and budget, from small websites and student projects to larger systems for businesses. The first call is free, and we agree the price in writing before any work starts.

faqs.question: How does your process work?
faqs.answer: Four steps: 1) Understand your goal on a free call. 2) A clear written plan with timeline and price. 3) We build in short steps and show you working progress along the way. 4) We launch, hand everything over and stay available for support.

faqs.question: How long does a project take?
faqs.answer: A simple website can take a week or two. Most apps, automations and CRM setups take three to six weeks, and ERP rollouts can take longer. We give you a timeline in the written plan before starting.

faqs.question: How do I get started?
faqs.answer: Click any Book a Call button and tell us briefly what you want to build or improve. We will reply to set up a free call.

faqs.question: Show me your work.
faqs.answer: BrandPulse is a new company and we are taking on our first clients, so we will not show you made-up case studies. Each service page shows a real project from our team's own work, such as Varad's AI insurance recommender, Abhijeet's Financial Health Predictor and Atharva's social media automation tool. Our team section links to each founder's portfolio.

faqs.question: Who is on the BrandPulse team?
faqs.answer: Four co-founders from Pune: Varad (AI/ML engineer), Abhijeet (business and technology, with experience at EY and Bajaj Finance), Atharva (data science and automation, co-founder of Quagster) and Yash (business development).

faqs.question: Where is BrandPulse based?
faqs.answer: We are based in Pune, India, and work with clients remotely as well as in person in Pune.

faqs.question: How do I contact BrandPulse?
faqs.answer: Email us at varadpendkar@gmail.com or use any Book a Call button on this site to send us your project details.

faqs.question: How do I book a call?
faqs.answer: Click any [ BOOK A CALL ] button on the website, fill in a few details about your project, and we will get back to you to schedule a free call.

faqs.question: What makes BrandPulse different?
faqs.answer: You work directly with the four founders who build your project, with no middlemen. We cover tech, AI, marketing and business under one roof, scope work to your budget, and show you working progress early so you can give feedback.
